title: Browser smoke test (tools/browser-smoke.cjs): logged-in trading + admin flows, 14/14 checks
notes: Verified in the real app: demo login; BUY opens the trade-confirmation sheet when the Settings toggle is on and Cancel places no stake (c0011); chat send clears the input and drops focus, sender name renders above the message (c0010); admin login reaches /admin with no redirect loop, a USER-role login lands on the 403 page and 'Sign in with another account' clears the session (c0007); Risk Management Terminal and NPC Simulator tabs render. Finding: admin/src/Pages/AdminDashboard/NpcSimulator.css @imports Google Fonts; when fonts.googleapis.com is unreachable (ad-blocker, firewall, offline) the whole /admin lazy chunk fails to preload its CSS and the dashboard shows 'React Application Error'. The smoke tool stubs the font host; the product fix (move the font <link> to index.html or self-host) is proposed, not applied.
